'''Agamarian soybeans''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of bean&mdash;a type of [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetable]]&mdash;from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]],<ref name="DaD" /> an [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="NJOS">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref> They were used to make the patties served in [[Agamar slider]]s, a dish sold for 6.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The sliders could be eaten by [[Vegetarian/Legends|vegetarians]] and Besalisks, consisting of the patty topped with [[Mugruebe spit-sauce]] and a slice of [[Binka fruit]], served with a [[Slider garnish|special garnish]]. Agamarian [[slider]]s were served at Dex's<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Agamarian soybeans were created for the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]].<ref name="DaD" />
